evaluation.reason: The scoped evidence supports the hypothesis as stated. VALIDATION.md names the required contract: request size limits must respect app configuration and per-request overrides. The test contract in tests/test_request.py requires three behaviors for Request.max_content_length: outside app context it is None, inside app context it reflects app.config["MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH"], and an explicit per-request override wins regardless of context. The implementation in src/flask/wrappers.py preserves override precedence by returning self._max_content_length when set and falls back to Werkzeug defaults when there is no current_app, but in the app-context/no-override path it returns None instead of consulting current_app config. src/flask/app.py defines MAX_CONTENT_LENGTH in default config, so this is not explained by a missing config key. That directly contradicts the required in-app-context behavior and establishes a concrete current defect in request size limit handling.
